A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a perovskite film deposited on a textured crystalline silicon substrate with a surface roughness of 100 nm and an effective thickness of the perovskites of 300 nm would be the optimal interface morphology for perovskite silicon tandem solar cells.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the growth of the perovskites on textured silicon solar cells is a key factor for the implementation of high efficiency tandem solar cells.
an efficient photon management can be achieved by a combination of the growth mode of the perovskites on the silicon and the silicon surface texturing.
